datasheet.title: NavePoint 1U Rack Mount Cable Management Panel with Tidy Brush Slot, Black (product page, SKU 00401654, saved 2026-11-11)

description: 1U brush panel, NavePoint 00401654: a black cold rolled steel panel the full width of the rack, with flanged edges. A slot of nylon bristles lets cables pass through. The page lists a cable support bar with tie-down points.

gaps.note: the page states no product weight and the product's own record in the page holds none; none is recorded.
the page gives no slot size or place; the window is estimated.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the panel

gaps.note: the bullets mention a support bar with tie-downs and the page gives no size, place or depth; it is not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the support bar

gaps.note: "Lip: Flanged" with no size; the flanges are drawn folded back the page's 0.31 in.
the page states no cable capacity, so none is recorded or estimated.

body.description: the steel panel, its ears and its flanges

brush.note: estimated - the page says "high-density nylon brush bristles" and gives no window size; 382.6 x 20.45 mm, centred between the ears.

chassis.note: page - 482.6 x 44.45 x 7.87; the 0.31 in is the projection the page calls External Width. The cable support bar the bullets mention may reach further; see `gaps`.

color.note: estimated - black powder coat; no photograph is held.

front.note: estimated - the plate with the brush window and its bristles.

method.note: FIGURES FROM A PRODUCT PAGE, NO DRAWING. NavePoint publishes no datasheet or drawing for this part. The held page (NavePoint product page for 00401654 (navepoint-1u-rack-mount-cable-management-panel-with-tidy-brush-slot-black.txt, saved 2026-11-11)) gives External Height 1.75", External Width 0.31", External Depth 19", Venting Style Non-vented, Lip Flanged, Rack Capacity 1U, Material Cold Rolled Steel, Finish Powder Coated and the hardware (four M6 screws, washers and cage nuts). It gives no size or place for the brush slot or the support bar: the slot is drawn as a window in the middle of the panel and its size is estimated. No product photograph is held, so the shape was not checked and nothing was copied.

mount.note: estimated - "Simply mount to any open space in the front or rear of your rack"; taken as a rack-face part flush with the rail face.

passes.note: estimated - the brush slot is the pass-through, declared `brush` over the estimated window: "Brush panels allow cables to pass from rack front to rear".

rear.note: estimated - the back of the plate and the bristles, the front seen from behind.
